lead.en: Thon Buri khet is west-bank family Bangkok at its most affordable: seven khwaeng of markets, temples and low-rise streets between the Chao Phraya and the khlongs, served by BTS Pho Nimit, Talat Phlu and Wutthakat plus the Maeklong-line terminal at Wongwian Yai. Registered population has fallen 57% since 1992 to 98,286, rents run from about 11,500 THB, and the food story is Talat Phlu's decades-old shops - nationally famous again after the 2024 film. The trade-offs are structural: the researched comparison set's lowest green (4.6 ha, 0.6%), no full-service hospital inside the khet, and the BTS Wongwian Yai terminus itself sitting across the Khlong San line.

strengths.en: Cheapest of the researched comparison set with real transit: 1-bed portal averages ~USD 387 (13-14k THB), three in-polygon BTS Silom stations, the Maeklong terminal and the west bank's biggest bus hub.
Authentic old-Bangkok texture: Talat Phlu's 80-year dessert shop and 60-year khao mu dang, the Kudi Chin riverfront and the new Memorial Bridge-to-Wat Kalayanamit walkway.

tradeoffs.en: Green 4 is the honest floor: no district-scale park inside the khet - the main named green is a ~10-rai pocket park, and the riverside showpiece (Chao Phraya Sky Park) is outside the polygon.
No full-service hospital verified inside the khet: Siriraj is Bangkok Noi across the canal, and the wikis' Somdech Phra Pinklao entry falls outside the app polygon too.

dayNight.en: Days follow the market-and-school rhythm around Talat Phlu and the BTS band, with the Maeklong train cutting through the market street; nights are local and early - the Wongwian Yai junction quiets with the buses, and the khet has no late-night strip of its own.

variation.en: The riverfront Wat Kanlaya heritage strip, the Talat Phlu-Bukkhalo market band along the BTS line, and the interior Samre/Wutthakat/Dao Khanong khwaeng are three different neighbourhoods - with the northern tip (Santa Cruz/Kudi Chin) clipped out of the app polygon entirely.

fit.en: Choose it if cheap long-term rent (12-14k for a 1-bed) with BTS access and an old-market, family-neighbourhood texture outweighs park access and late-night options.
Skip it if you need parks at the door, a hospital in-district, or the named 'Wongwian Yai' BTS address - that terminus is administratively Khlong San's.

uncertainties: Unresolved: composition of the app's 4.6-ha park figure; Somdech Phra Pinklao Hospital's true khet membership; Purple Line opening target (~2030, snippet-level); Maeklong-line frequency; Kudi Chin walkway's formal opening date. BTS Wongwian Yai = Khlong San khet is resolved; anchors verified against OSM with no mismatch beyond the northern-tip clip.

limitations: no khwaeng is named for the BTS station itself; placement inferred from the infobox district + PIP
